settings._comment: cert MUST be the public hostname you route through Cloudflare (e.g. mesh.example.com). MeshCentral bakes it into the agent connection URLs.
settings._ports: MeshCentral listens HTTP on 4430 internally (TLS is terminated by Cloudflare); cloudflared connects there over http. aliasPort advertises the public 443 to agents/browsers.
settings._TlsOffload: MUST be true behind Cloudflare Tunnel (or any TLS-terminating proxy). Cloudflare presents its OWN cert to agents; with offload, agents authenticate via the server's agent cert instead of pinning the TLS cert. If false, agents fail with 'bad web cert hash, holding connection'.

domains.title: Home Lab Remote Access
domains._newAccounts: Leave true ONLY until you have created your first account (it auto-becomes site admin). Then set to false and restart to lock down registration.
